lines.en: This strapping young lad sitting here is Phyllis' father, Albert, and he is quite the ladies' man, aren't you, Albert?
Huh? Ah, ring bear. I could have done better. I will do better. I am going to be better.
I can't believe I'm actually doing this. Are you ready for this, Albert? I am. Let's do it.
Me walking Phyllis down the aisle was supposed to be the highlight of the wedding, and now the wedding has no highlight.
I can't believe I pushed that, that guy's lazy ass around all day until he was ready to stand up and steal the show.
That's, well, I got news for you, Albert. If that's your real name, the show's not over.
And do you, Phyllis, take Bob Vance, Vance Refrigeration, to be your lawfully wedded husband?
Ladies and gentlemen, may I present to you, for the first time as a couple, Mr. and Mrs. Bob Vance!
And do you, Bob, take Phyllis to be your lawfully wedded wife?
You may now kiss the bride.
Ladies and gentlemen, for the first time as a couple, Mr. and Mrs. Bob Vance!
